idea: How to prevent bathroom pipe problems
title: Simple Habits to Protect Your Bathroom Pipes
description: Bathroom plumbing works hard every day, but a few simple habits can prevent costly drain backups and pipe damage. Start by installing hair catchers in your shower and tub drains to trap debris before it enters your pipes. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper down the toilet, including wipes labeled as flushable. Never pour harsh chemical drain cleaners down your sinks, as they can corrode pipes over time. Instead, clear minor clogs gently or call a licensed plumber for safe, thorough cleaning. Regular maintenance and professional inspections ensure your system stays in top shape year-round.
